front: What is GitHub Actions in one sentence?
back: Event-driven CI/CD defined in YAML under .github/workflows/ — jobs run on Github runner instances.

front: Explain the mental model of GitHub Actions (how the system thinks).
back: Secrets live in GitHub (secrets.*, vars.*); never commit them. Expressions ${{ }} access context (github, env, matrix).

front: Which standard commands / workflow do you use for GitHub Actions?
back: Trigger (push, PR, cron, dispatch)

front: What are the production-safe defaults for GitHub Actions?
back: Settings → Code security → Code scanning → disable tool (prefer fixing findings over disabling in prod repos).

front: Symptom: Workflow not triggering — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: on: branch/path filters · Fix: Match branch name; use workflow_dispatch to test

front: Symptom: Secret empty in log — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: secrets scope (env vs repo) · Fix: Set secret at correct level; fork PRs don't get secrets

front: Symptom: ubuntu-latest tool missing — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Runner image changelog · Fix: Pin actions/setup-* or explicit apt install

front: Symptom: YAML invalid — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Actions tab error · Fix: Validate indentation; tabs break YAML

front: Symptom: Cron didn't run — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: GitHub schedule delay · Fix: Cron is best-effort; can slip minutes on busy repos

front: Symptom: Action pin drift — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: @v4 vs SHA · Fix: Pin major tag or full SHA for supply-chain safety

front: Gotcha with GitHub Actions: what silently fails?
back: pull_request from forks — secrets unavailable; use pull_request_target only with extreme care (RCE risk). Cache poisoning across branches — scope cache keys with ${{ github.ref }}. Reusable workflow inputs — untrusted input in run: = injection; pass as env, not string concat in script.

front: When should you NOT use GitHub Actions?
back: Don't run long-lived servers in Actions — use deploy targets (k8s, Lambda, VM). Don't replace proper secret manager (Vault, AWS SM) with hundreds of repo secrets for shared infra creds.

front: What is GitHub CLI (gh) in one sentence?
back: Terminal interface for auth, PRs, issues, secrets, and API — faster than clicking through github.com during incidents.

front: Explain the mental model of GitHub CLI (gh) (how the system thinks).
back: gh wraps GitHub REST/GraphQL with repo-aware defaults (current directory's remote). Auth is per-host (github.com, GHES). Most commands accept --json for scripting. Secrets and variables are scoped: repo, environment, or org.

front: Which standard commands / workflow do you use for GitHub CLI (gh)?
back: gh auth login # browser or token → gh auth status → gh auth switch --hostname github.com --user other-account → gh api user --jq '.login' → gh pr create --base main --head feature/x --title "fix: …" --body "…"

front: Given a broken GitHub CLI (gh) setup, what is your first validation command?
back: gh auth login # browser or token

front: Symptom: HTTP 401 — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: gh auth status · Fix: gh auth login or refresh token

front: Symptom: HTTP 403 on secret set — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Repo admin? · Fix: Need maintain/admin; org secrets need org role

front: Symptom: Wrong repo context — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: gh repo view · Fix: cd to repo root or -R owner/repo

front: Symptom: gh pr create no commits — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: git status · Fix: Push branch first

front: Symptom: API rate limit — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: gh api rate_limit · Fix: Wait or use PAT with higher limit

front: Gotcha with GitHub CLI (gh): what silently fails?
back: gh repo delete --yes — no undo; prefer archive for mistakes. Secrets echo in shell history — pipe from file or env: gh secret set KEY < secret.txt. GHES hostname — must pass --hostname on every command or set default during login.

front: When should you NOT use GitHub CLI (gh)?
back: Don't use gh in CI instead of GITHUB_TOKEN + native actions — use gh locally and in ad-hoc scripts. Don't store long-lived PATs in shell profiles — use gh auth login credential store.

front: What is GitHub Actions runner in one sentence?
back: Machine that executes workflow jobs — GitHub-hosted VM or your own hardware with the runner agent.

front: Explain the mental model of GitHub Actions runner (how the system thinks).
back: A workflow triggers on events; jobs run on a runner (isolated VM or your server). The runner pulls job steps, checks out code, runs actions/commands, uploads artifacts/logs. GitHub-hosted runners are ephemeral; self-hosted runners are persistent and inherit your network/VPC access.

front: Which standard commands / workflow do you use for GitHub Actions runner?
back: Event → Workflow → Job(s) → Runner agent → Steps (checkout, build, deploy)

front: Given a broken GitHub Actions runner setup, what is your first validation command?
back: Event → Workflow → Job(s) → Runner agent → Steps (checkout, build, deploy)

front: What are the production-safe defaults for GitHub Actions runner?
back: runs-on: [self-hosted, gpu] — match runner labels at registration time.

front: Symptom: Job queued forever — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Runners offline in Settings · Fix: Start runner service; check ./run.sh logs

front: Symptom: Self-hosted wrong user/env — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Service account · Fix: Install runner as dedicated user; fix PATH

front: Symptom: Out of disk on hosted runner — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Large artifacts/cache · Fix: Trim cache; use actions/upload-artifact retention

front: Symptom: Can't reach internal API — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Network · Fix: Self-hosted in VPC; or OIDC + private endpoint

front: Symptom: Duplicate deploys — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Missing concurrency · Fix: Add concurrency group

front: Symptom: Runner not picking job — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Label mismatch · Fix: Align runs-on labels with runner registration

front: Gotcha with GitHub Actions runner: what silently fails?
back: Self-hosted = arbitrary code execution — fork PRs can run untrusted workflows unless you restrict pull_request_target / approvals. Shared self-hosted runner — one compromised job reads others' secrets; use ephemeral runners or one runner per repo. GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest drift — image updates break apt packages; pin tool versions in workflow.

front: When should you NOT use GitHub Actions runner?
back: Don't run self-hosted runners on a laptop — sleep, IP changes, security nightmare. Don't use larger hosted runners for lint-only jobs — cost adds up fast.
